html:
BBCode与HTML互转

HTML预览

支持的标签对照

[b]...[/b] ↔ <strong>...</strong>
[i]...[/i] ↔ <em>...</em>
[u]...[/u] ↔ <u>...</u>
[s]...[/s] ↔ <s>...</s>
[url=...]...[/url] ↔ <a href="...">...</a>
[img]...[/img] ↔ <img src="...">
[color=...]...[/color] ↔ <span style="color:...">
[size=...]...[/size] ↔ <span style="font-size:...">
[quote]...[/quote] ↔ <blockquote>...</blockquote>
[code]...[/code] ↔ <pre><code>...</code></pre>
[list][*]...[/list] ↔ <ul><li>...</li></ul>
[center]...[/center] ↔ <div style="text-align:center">
